name: Certificate Management Request V 08
definition: The CertificateManagementRequest message is sent by a POI terminal or any intermediary entity either to a terminal manager acting as a certificate authority for managing X.509 certificate of a public key owned by the initiating party, or for requesting the inclusion or the removal of the POI to a white list of the terminal manager.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management.

CertificateManagementRequest.name: Certificate Management Request
CertificateManagementRequest.definition: Information related to the request of certificate management.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC or a digital signature.
